name: Demo — Operation Wocao
description: Demo scenario inspired by publicly documented Operation Wocao espionage activity. It condenses and enriches reported tradecraft into logical layers for visualization and is not an authoritative incident reconstruction.

layers.name: EXT-INFRA
layers.description: External adversary infrastructure layer for target research, acquired servers and accounts, public tooling, and multi-hop operations.

layers.name: DMZ-REMOTE
layers.description: Perimeter remote-access layer covering exposed application services, stolen VPN access, and web-based or proxied connectivity.

techniques.comment: Non-standard protocol use is marked seen; protocol details remain useful analyst context.

layers.name: INT-ENDPOINT
layers.description: Internal privileged endpoint layer for script execution, credential and MFA capture, process injection, and host-control evasion.

layers.name: INT-NETWORK
layers.description: Internal network layer for discovering accounts, services, shares, and storage, moving tools, collecting data, and removing traces.

techniques.comment: File deletion activity is marked seen after collection and staging in this demo.
